title: Tim Dooley — November 5, 2026 Evidence Update: Latin America, Greenland, Israel
status: dated source audit / one newly matched directional candidate + two new external confirmations of existing forecast families; no strict-hit promotion
purpose: Document later independent events against earlier, attributable Tim wording without turning broad trends, prior policy or post-event interpretations into newly invented predictions.

counting.rule: The three later-country developments after August 29 are dependent atoms of one compound Latin-America call, not three statistically independent hits. The Greenland and Israel updates only corroborate previously catalogued families.

cases.status: newly matched directional/compound forecast; C partial/mixed (not strict A)

prior_statement.source_class: direct user-authored prior-conversation fragments retrieved from conversation history; no preserved full public permalink

commit more military … right wing stuff, and incersions
prior_statement.recovered_context: Tim described greater U.S. influence toward South America/Latin America, possible military and right-leaning alignment, and strategic-resource access/excavation.
prior_statement.missing: Full contiguous wording and any initial horizon/criteria; fragments are fixed as recovered, not silently completed.

frozen_comparable_atoms.claim: greater U.S. southern influence and strategic mineral/resource deals
increased/direct U.S. military involvement on land in Latin America
new right-wing governments/alignment linked directly to prediction
military incursions undertaken specifically to extract resources

post_statement_outcomes.event: Colombia's Foreign Ministry confirmed the U.S. visit and bilateral instruments covering strategic mineral supply chains and civilian nuclear cooperation in its September 9 statement.

U.S. EXIM and Argentina signed a framework mobilizing up to $7 billion in financing through 2027 for critical minerals, energy and associated infrastructure; framework is not $7 billion already invested.
A counter-cartel raid in Ecuador included U.S. forces and DEA officers; the direct ground role was described by the Soufan Center on October 22.

preexisting_trend_controls: U.S. maritime counternarcotics strikes began in 2025, prior to the prediction.
U.S. action against Maduro and U.S. activity in Venezuela predated August 29, 2026.
U.S. cooperation on critical minerals with Latin American states already existed, including an agreement with El Salvador in January 2026 and with Mexico in February.
Some right-leaning government alignments and Argentina–U.S. ties predated this statement.
mismatches_and_limits: No evidence the 2026 September military operations were conducted to obtain mineral resources.
The forecast was broadly regional and used conditional 'may' language, not a named-country or time-bounded event forecast.
Statements about increasing influence are relative to a trend already visible before August 29.
cases.assessment: A dated, attributable forward judgment followed by multiple relevant events in the predicted region. Count as one compound directional match with meaningful limitations; not a new strict fulfilled prediction.

post_statement_outcome.event: Greenland's parliament ratified a September agreement allowing a stronger U.S. security role while reaffirming Danish sovereignty and Greenlandic self-determination, by 16 votes to none with seven abstentions; Denmark's vote still pending.

limits: January sovereignty statement was a political boundary and warning, not an exact forecast of a November parliamentary vote.
The full specific access menu was assistant elaboration.
This continuation of the already catalogued North family must not increase strict-hit count.

cases.status: fresh later confirmation of existing Israel-leverage family, not independent new prediction

prior_statement.recovered_summary: Tim forecast Israel would find political leverage/support harder to obtain.

post_statement_outcome.event: Trump announced a proposed end to about $4 billion/year in U.S. funding to Israel after 2026, citing political controversy, while continuing weapon sales; implementation unclear due to existing aid agreement through 2028 and Congress.

limits: The announcement is not proof U.S. aid actually stopped.
One shift in U.S. aid policy does not exhaust 'political leverage'; the earlier forecast was already counted once.

resolution_protocol: Recover exact earliest words and date.
Freeze the interpreted target before checking results.
Separate literal, structural and symbolic correspondences.
Write down mismatches and trends already under way.
Classify rather than impose fulfilled/failed binary.
Avoid duplicate counting and assistant-to-Tim attribution transfer.
